headline: Hearing on Eastview amendment at 500 Old Farm Road closed; 1720 Spear Street housing project continued to January 5, 2027.
summary: Green Mountain Habitat's plan for three four-family homes at 1720 Spear Street depends on a subdivision that was denied, and the applicant is working with City Council on the right-of-way issue behind that denial. At Eastview, the amendment would allow attached garages on 17 alley-loaded homes and remove one cottage home, and the hearing closed with conditions on home mix and layout to follow.
decisions: Continued the Green Mountain Habitat site plan at 1720 Spear Street to January 5, 2027; motion carried.
Closed the public hearing on the amended final plat for the Eastview PUD at 500 Old Farm Road; motion carried.
discussion: Spear Street timing: Members said an updated site plan was still owed. They chose January 5 as the next hearing and said they would conclude the review if the applicant did not attend.

Eastview home types: The applicant said the cottage homes did not sell and proposed a larger attached-garage home. The applicant later offered a 1,600-square-foot option on the former cottage lots as well.
Garage and lawn space: Members weighed whether attached garages would reduce usable yard space. They discussed mirrored layouts and alternating driveways to avoid a repeated look along the row.

Grading and elevation: Some lots would sit about 4 feet higher than the approved plan, a change members called substantive. Members said they were comfortable with it and asked for a closer look at the grading plan.
Stormwater impact: The applicant said added impervious coverage is about a tenth of an acre. Stormwater permit inspections and renewal would track any net increase.

decision_evidence.quote: So, I make a motion to continue this hearing to January 5th, 2027. Seconded. Uh, great. All those in favor? Aye. Aye. Any opposed? Abstain? Okay, motion carries. Uh, application's continued till January 5th, 2027.
I would entertain a motion to close PZ-FINAL-2026-7. So moved. Second. All right. All those in favor? Aye. Aye. All those opposed? None. Motion carries.

decision_titles: Green Mountain Habitat site plan at 1720 Spear Street (SP-26-07)
Eastview PUD amendment at 500 Old Farm Road (PZ-FINAL-2026-7)
